The '''Jillion Bolts Company''' was a company that operated during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:ES">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=other|Endor system}}</ref>

==History==
During [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], the Jillion Bolts Company employed [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture Droids]] to combat the [[Sanyassan Marauders/Legends|Marauder]] [[Starship/Legends|starships]] which looted the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Miner/Legends|miners]] in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]]. They primarily operated out of the [[Empire's Justice]] quadrant.

Sub-classes of ''Vulture''-class starfighters used by the Jillion Bolts Company included DQ-9 Fighters and E-70 Engineers.<ref name="SWG:ES" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Jillion Bolts Company appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:ES" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Jillion Bolts Company was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:ES" />
